app_attestation_initialization_rule: Initialize android_hardware_backed_keyinfo_policy only from compiled and runtime evidence that AndroidKeyStore KeyInfo rejects software-backed keys; initialize play_integrity_cloud_project_number only from the exact Google Cloud project bound into the compiled manifest; and initialize play_integrity_policy_id only from the deployed server verdict policy. This local KeyInfo gate is not a claim of challenge-bound Android key-attestation certificate-chain verification.
initialization_rule: Populate the fleet fields only from an independently verified Play app-signing APK and the upload fields only from the independently verified Play upload certificate and accepted AAB; never infer, cross-copy, or substitute those distinct identities, and never copy Custodial signer values.
advancement_rule: After initialization, advance the highest and minimum-next version codes only after the production Manager AAB is accepted and the corresponding Play app-signing APK is independently verified.
